candidates.statement: Checkout POST /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because the inventory service's redis.reserve_inventory operation times out (DependencyUnavailable: redis operation failed), propagating 503 from /v1/reservations and ReadTimeout transport errors up through order to the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not observed; timeout cause (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show a consistent chain: gateway /v1/checkout 502 after ~2s, order ReadTimeout, inventory /v1/reservations 503, and redis.reserve_inventory timeout with DependencyUnavailable. Metrics show checkout 502s and p95 ~2387ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis dependency metrics (latency, errors, saturation) for inventory service
Inventory service logs confirming redis timeout root cause
